$comment: The decoded text of every solved Liber Primus page. DERIVED by running the cipher over the canonical runes, not transcribed from a wiki. Generated by liber-primus/analysis/handoff/build_solved_pages.py.
reading_note: The transliteration is LOSSY, which is why the text looks misspelled. The runic alphabet has 29 symbols and no K, Q, V or Z: K is written C, V is written U, and seven runes expand to two letters (TH EO NG OE AE IA EA). So 'KNOW' appears as 'CNOW', 'BELIEVE' as 'BELIEUE', 'THINGS' as 'THNGS'. These are faithful outputs, not decoding errors.
interrupter_note: The rune F (index 0) sometimes acts as a skip marker rather than a letter. The count of interrupters found per page is recorded below; a decode that ignores them will not produce readable text.
unsolved: LP2 pages 0-54, totalling 12,956 runes, remain UNSOLVED. See PROBLEM.json.

pages.title: SOME WISDOM
pages.note: Direct transliteration, no key. States the puzzle's own theology of primes.

pages.title: A KOAN (the master and the student)
pages.note: Atbash plus a Caesar shift of 3.

pages.title: WELCOME
pages.note: Vigenere with key DIVINITY, plus interrupter runes that must be skipped.

pages.title: A KOAN (the circumference)
pages.note: Vigenere with key FIRFUMFERENFE - 'CIRCUMFERENCE' written in the lossy runic alphabet, where C and F share a rune. The key is a pun on the alphabet itself.
